name: Long-Range RFID Reading
description: Standard RFID readers have a read range of a few centimeters. Weaponized long-range readers extend this to several feet, enabling credential capture at a natural standoff distance — shaking someone's hand, standing behind them in line, or sitting nearby in a lobby. The captured data is then used to clone a credential for later replay. This technique requires careful scoping with the client, as it directly captures employee credentials.

blue.det: Individual with directional antenna near entry points; unusual equipment near access readers.
blue.cm: OSDP encrypted readers defeat Wiegand-based skimming; reader covers and shields; relocate readers away from exterior walls.
